name: rails-layered
description: Layered Rails 8 architecture: service, query, form, policy and presenter objects, RSpec + FactoryBot, Pundit, ViewComponent, Tailwind, PostgreSQL.

interface.shortDescription: Layered Rails 8: services, queries, forms, policies, presenters, RSpec, Pundit
interface.longDescription: Conventions and skills for Rails 8 applications built on a layered architecture: service objects with a Result type, query objects, form objects, Pundit policies, presenters and ViewComponents, tested with RSpec and FactoryBot. Mutually exclusive with rails-37signals.
